compute_objectness_loss: compute objectness loss for 3D detection proposals by associating proposals with ground truth objects
get_loss: get total loss combining objectness, box, and semantic classification losses for 3D object detection
compute_box_and_sem_cls_loss: compute box regression and semantic classification losses for detected 3D bounding boxes
nn_distance: compute nearest neighbor distances between two point sets using CUDA-accelerated operations
huber_loss: compute huber loss for robust regression of bounding box parameters
